description: Change who can read an existing discussion comment on a work item: clientVisible true shares it with the client on shared reports, false takes it back to internal. Taking it back stops it being served from that moment but cannot retrieve what a reader has already seen. A reply can only be shared while the comment it answers is shared (409 parent_not_shared otherwise). Same rule as the Console: requires `write` scope and a key owner who is an editor or above; a key not bound to a user is refused. Find comment ids with anyforge_list_work_item_comments.

clientVisible.description: true shares the comment with the client on shared reports; false keeps it internal.

name: anyforge_share_work_item_comment
title: Share work item comment
